_about: B15's threshold fixture (docs/plans/B15-watch.md, Comparer): for each of the Diné co-op's 12 pieces, 3 look-alike and 3 unrelated listing texts, written once by the builder, invented, on example.com. No listing names the co-op or a maker, so only the text match tells them apart. server/b15_watch/calibrate.py scores them with the trained model and writes server/b15_watch/threshold.json.
